name: archer-kdl
description: Archer: Architecture as Code for Kubernetes deployment modeling

scripts.all: yarn clean && yarn install && yarn lint
scripts.build: yarn build:packages && yarn langium-generate && yarn compile && yarn bundle
scripts.bundle: yarn kdl-language build && yarn webview build && yarn extension build
scripts.build:packages: lerna run --scope=@kdl/protocol build && lerna run --scope=@kdl/glsp-client build
scripts.watch: concurrently --kill-others -n tsc,ext,gslp-server -c red,yellow,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput" "yarn -s extension watch:bundle" "yarn -s glsp-server watch:bundle"
